scope: Read-only QLD source review and local CSV checks for team decisions. No database, FP1 or publication validation.

local_file.parser: Python csv.DictReader; CSV logical records; no source changes

official_checks.publisher: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads

official_checks.note: Dictionary and reported count only. The metadata contains-all flag is false, so this API was not used as a complete-file substitute.

references.supports: Native key, date fields, severity, casualty and unit-category definitions, and GDA2020 coordinate datum.
Publisher, licence, version, published coverage, property-damage reporting cutoff and preliminary-data warning.
Thirty-day fatality definition, hospital transport, medical treatment and minor-injury definitions.
Transformation methods and independent software-validation references; not a validated GDA2020-to-WGS84 implementation.
WGS84 web-mapping accuracy limitations and datum-mixing risks.

local_scan.method: Streamed the existing CSV and hashed the original bytes. Held only keys, counters and a few example rows in memory; generated no intake JSONL.

analysis.box_note: A basic diagnostic only, not a geographic eligibility rule or CRS proof.

published_coverage.note: The general reporting cutoffs are not the selected resource coverage. The dataset warns that recent events may be preliminary; no finality guarantee is inferred from the update timestamp.

dictionary_discrepancy.description: The dictionary says the first four digits currently identify the crash year, but the local file uses IDs such as 1 and 2.
dictionary_discrepancy.proposed_handling: Preserve the unique native key as text, scoped by source and release. Read the year from Crash_Year, never from the identifier.

crs.proposed_current_handling: Keep official QLD map output disabled and preserve source coordinates in Raw. Other confirmed accident metrics can proceed.
crs.proposed_future_boundary: C supplies a versioned SQL location operation with explicit source/target CRS, axes, operation and parameters, accuracy and independent reference-point tests. B freezes its actual code/rule digest; E verifies QA07 before enabling map output. No new core table or mandatory PostGIS dependency.
crs.reference_access_limits: The EPSG operation 8450 page returned 403 and an old ICSM web-mapping PDF redirected to maintenance. No numerical conversion is claimed.

proposed_team_decisions.decision: Approve use of this exact pinned snapshot for QLD-only accident counts, native severity, fatal crashes, deaths and casualties for 2020-2024, subject to actual pipeline QA. Record a team release scope; do not imply publisher certification.

Use the five exact native severity values plus an explicit missing category. Fatal is true only for Fatal. Reject unregistered nonempty categories, including any new Non hospitalised casualty crash variant.
Keep occurrence_date NULL and month precision. Use native fatality and total casualty fields, validate their components, and never replace unknown counts with zero.
Keep Count_Unit_* as aggregate crash attributes. Do not create QLD unit/person records, relationships or a category fact table.
Describe 2020-2024 results as reported casualty crashes in the selected snapshot. No post-2010 PDO completeness claim and no harmonised cross-state total without a separate comparability rule.
Freeze GDA2020 as the known source datum; leave official map output unavailable until an explicit EPSG:4326 operation has been implemented and validated. Continue synthetic map development.
A new file hash or coverage change requires a new reviewed snapshot and explicit change explanation. Never treat matching counts, a recent URL or the API as proof that a future input is approved.

remaining_limits: This receipt records research and file checks; the proposed decisions are not runtime source approval.
No official projection, database load, full QA chain, FP1 or publication test was run.
Coordinate conversion remains unvalidated; native coordinate validity is not map eligibility.
